description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows and build solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.

The Sr. Customer Success Manager builds high-value, strategic relationships with a focused portfolio of large, complex enterprise customers. The role requires extensive experience in SaaS Customer Success, strong business acumen and exceptional communication skills.

The Sr. Customer Success Manager is expected to provide thought leadership and mentorship to CSMs, as well as lead and/or contribute to special programs and projects. For the right candidate, this is a career-defining opportunity to join the market leader in Smartsheet, the AI powered enterprise work management platform and help influence the future of Customer Success as a vocation.

This role reports to a Manager of Customer Success.

You Will:

Lead AI-First Transformation & Value Creation  

  • Act as a trusted advisor, partnering with customers to unlock the full potential of Smartsheet's platform from core workflows through to AI-powered capabilities that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Design and maintain AI Adoption Roadmaps and Customer Success Plans that connect Smartsheet's AI capabilities (agents, Smart Assist, and MCP connections to the AI tools customers already use), with adoption and usage as the measure of progress to each customer's strategic priorities and goals.

Executive Relationship Management

  • Be the single thread to the customer. Orchestrate Sales, Support, Professional Services, Product and Training so the customer has one owner, one cadence and one plan.
  • Build and sustain trusted, multi-threaded relationships at the VP and C-Suite level, owning and leading high-impact QBRs and Executive Business Reviews.
  • Navigate complex organizational structures to develop a robust stakeholder map, ensuring relationships are resilient to executive turnover and aligned to evolving business strategy.

Value Engineering

  • Onboarding and value realization: Lead onboarding for strategic customers, from planning through rollout and training. You understand each customer’s deployment and how it fits their broader business goals, partner hands-on with their teams to model best practices, and keep executive stakeholders informed as customers realize measurable value early and over time.
  • Define, track, and measure KPIs, mapping Smartsheet solution adoption directly to financial outcomes.
  • Transform standard Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) into executive briefings focused on realized value (efficiency gains, reduced operational risk, and tool consolidation savings).
  • Identify opportunities to expand adoption across underutilized features, untapped products, and new lines of business. When adoption stalls, diagnose root causes, design a path forward, and connect technical work to measurable business outcomes.
  • Own the path to resolution, diagnosing the issue and bringing in Support, SEs, Product or Engineering at the right moment for complex technical challenges raised by the Customer, involving Product or Engineering only when truly needed.
  • Assess account health, risks, stakeholder relationships, and the highest-priority problems to solve within your portfolio. Establish trust with customer stakeholders, then independently lead complex customer interactions that move accounts forward.

Commercial Growth & Renewal Strategy

  • Co-own Account Plans and Value Realization frameworks with Sales, driving renewal confidence, expansion, and measurable customer ROI.
  • Influence renewals in close partnership with internal teams, forming a cohesive approach to mitigate churn and identify expansion opportunities.
  • Positively impact revenue by coaching customers to develop and enhance solutions that translate directly into upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

Data-Driven

  • Use data to gain insights, provide guidance, increase customer adoption and proactively identify opportunities for expansion and risk mitigation.
  • Create and execute territory engagement plans and joint customer enablement plans grounded in customer-specific data, with a focus on value realization and tailored strategy.

Advocacy

  • Serve as a thought leader, advising customers on industry best practices and how to solve complex business problems using the Smartsheet platform.
  • Provide customer insight to internal teams,  Product, Marketing, and Sales,  to inform innovation, roadmap prioritization, and go-to-market strategy.

Risk Management

  • Identify risk the week it appears, with an owner, a plan and a loss range, and maintain an accurate renewal forecast. across your book of business, deploying targeted mitigation strategies to protect retention and customer health.
  • Understand each customer's business model, go-to-market strategy, and organizational structure to anticipate risk and build proactive, customer-specific engagement plans.

Smartsheet Platform SME

  • Manage a focused portfolio of large, complex accounts, with a focus on engagement, enablement and adoption across the full Smartsheet platform.
  • Maintain strong fluency of Smartsheets Core Product, enough to diagnose customer needs and bring in the right specialist and Premium Application SME, mastering best practices and enablement strategies to accelerate product adoption across your customer base.
  • Effectively partner with cross-functional teams - Sales, Training, Product, Professional Services - to deliver a unified, cohesive, and elite customer experience.

You Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success Manager, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, or solutions architecture , with a strong background in SaaS and enterprise customers.
  • Strategic mindset that anticipates where the market, the customer, and the business are heading,  connecting long-term trends to near-term account strategy before others see the need.
  • Deeply attuned to the goals, pressures, and success metrics of the customer's business, treating their outcomes as the primary measure of success.
  • Actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to evolve how value is delivered, problems are solved, and customer relationships are scaled.
  • Operates with autonomy across complex, strategically important accounts, managing escalations with minimal oversight.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives with measurable outcomes tied to retention, expansion, and strategic alignment.
  • Established VP and C-suite relationships within large enterprise organizations, engaging as a trusted advisor who influences adoption and investment decisions.
  • Good understanding of core business finance metrics, including ROI, TCO, labor costing, and operational expenditure (OpEx) reduction.
  • Comfortable presenting financial data and strategic roadmaps directly to economic buyers and VP/C-level executives.
  • Expert in outcome-based account strategy at enterprise scale, linking platform adoption to measurable ROI and multi-year value realization.
  • Deep subject matter expertise in Customer Success strategy, actively mentoring peers and contributing to product feedback loops.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for customer meetings and QBRs, if required.

Nice to Haves

  • Up-to-date Smartsheet Certifications (Core Product, System Administrator, Project Management, Control Center Lead, Control Center Blueprint Builder) or the ability to obtain within 6 months.
  • Deep understanding of Project Management Offices (PMO), Agile methodologies, resource management, and strategic portfolio execution. Knowledge of Smartsheet architectural capabilities is highly preferred.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$112,500—$142,500 USD

 

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
